old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-z22y","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-zvp7: TH_4 hashes PLAINTEXT_3 instead of CIPHERTEXT_3","description":"In edhoc.rs:881, transcript_4 is called with plaintext_3 (the pre-encryption message_3 payload, 50 bytes) but RFC 9528 Section 4.1 specifies TH_4 = H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3). This is a correctness and security bug — the transcript hash will not match other implementations. The comment at line 433 correctly says CBOR(CIPHERTEXT_3) but the code on line 441 hashes plaintext. Call sites: line 881 (prepare_message_3), line 1309 (process_message_3), line 1599 (test).
